title: V1 Acceptance MEDIUM — telemetry terminal-state validation
description: Stage C Test 2 legitimate governance-data integrity improvement. Restrict token telemetry terminal_state values to canonical terminal outcomes so malformed or invented terminal labels cannot enter deterministic calibration records. Preserve existing explicit-usage, integrity, persistence and readback behavior.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage C Test 2 must classify MEDIUM from the telemetry-governance change itself. It requires independent deterministic Review plus Verification and exact-artifact ACTIVE LOCK. Human Gate is not required unless effective risk escalates to HIGH.

acceptance_criteria.description: normalizeUsageEvent accepts only canonical terminal outcomes MERGED and ABORTED when terminal_state is present, and continues to allow omission/null for non-terminal telemetry events.
Invented, malformed or non-terminal workflow labels such as HUMAN_PENDING, FAILED_LABEL or arbitrary text are rejected before record construction or persistence.
Canonical MERGED telemetry remains eligible for calibration when not human-rejected, while ABORTED telemetry remains retained but excluded from primary calibration.
The PR changes exactly the five authorized telemetry/governance paths and does not mutate runtime product code, APIs, database, dependencies, workflows, protection or risk controllers.
Deterministic classification remains MEDIUM with Review plus Verification and Human Gate not required; any escalation to HIGH fails closed.
Exact-head verify, Phase A and merge-policy pass before protected workflow_dispatch merge, followed by exact-SHA postmerge verification before Test 2 completion is claimed.
